fix(thread-ui): replace BottomAppBar with Material to fix mouse click failures

BottomAppBar creates an internal _BottomAppBarClipper that can trigger
re-entrant MouseTracker updates, causing intermittent '!_debugDuringDeviceUpdate'
assertion failures. Using Material with SafeArea provides the same visual
behavior without the hit testing issue.
